about: I am a final-year B.Tech Computer Science student at PES University. I came to the degree through a diploma in Computer Science at Gomatesh Polytechnic, where I graduated with a 9.30 CGPA.

Most of what I build sits where web development meets finance: a valuation engine that prices shares from their dividends, and a quantitative analysis platform that combines Node.js with a Python model. I enjoy the backend side most, designing REST APIs, caching slow data sources and keeping the data model simple.
Outside project work I practise data structures and algorithms, with more than 100 problems solved on LeetCode across arrays, dynamic programming, graphs and trees.
I speak English, Hindi and Kannada, and I am looking for a full-stack developer role or internship.
basavaraj.seeking: I am open to full-stack developer roles and internships. Email is the fastest way to reach me.

projects.name: Intrinsic Equity Valuation Engine
projects.summary: A full-stack tool that estimates what a share is worth from the dividends it pays, then checks the estimate against five years of history.
bullets: Built a full-stack stock valuation system based on the Dividend Discount Model (DDM).
Integrated CAPM to compute a risk-adjusted discount rate from each stock's beta.
Backtested 5 years of financial data to evaluate valuation-based strategies.
Visualized Sharpe ratio, drawdown and return against a benchmark with Chart.js.
projects.tagline: What is a share actually worth?
projects.problem: A share's price is easy to look up. Whether that price is justified by the dividends the company pays is not.
projects.solution: A full-stack tool that values a share from its dividends with the Dividend Discount Model, uses CAPM and the stock's beta to set a risk-adjusted discount rate, and then backtests the result against five years of financial data.
features: CAPM discount rate from each stock's beta
Sharpe ratio, drawdown and benchmark return charts

projects.name: Equity Tracker & Quantitative Analyzer
projects.summary: A quantitative analysis platform that pairs a Node.js application with a Python service for the numerical work.
bullets: Developed a full-stack quantitative analysis platform using Node.js and Python.
Built a machine-learning model that reached about 75% prediction accuracy.
Reduced external API calls by about 40% with SQLite caching.
Implemented RSI, MACD and momentum indicators for trading insights.
projects.tagline: Market data, indicators and a prediction model in one place.
projects.problem: Analysing a stock means fetching the same market data again and again and recomputing the same indicators every time.
projects.solution: A quantitative analysis platform split in two: a Node.js application for the product and a Python FastAPI service for the numerical work with Pandas and NumPy. It computes RSI, MACD and momentum indicators, runs a machine-learning prediction model and caches API responses in SQLite.
architecture: Pandas, NumPy and the ML model
features: SQLite caching of external API responses

metrics.label: fewer external API calls with SQLite caching, as reported
